decisionReason: The official site, documentation and Apache-2.0 repository verify the current workflow, supported platforms, provider model, privacy boundary and free open-source license. The candidate can enter draft review but is not automatically publishable.
detail: Emdash is a free, open-source desktop environment for running multiple CLI coding agents in parallel. Each task can use an isolated Git worktree and retain its branch, terminal, conversation and review state. The app supports local projects and remote machines over SSH, connects issue sources to agent tasks, and brings diffs, pull requests and CI checks into one workflow.
limitations: Emdash orchestrates separate coding-agent CLIs; each provider can still require its own installation, account, authentication or paid access.
The application stores its own state locally, but selected agent providers may transmit code, prompts and context under their separate data policies.
Worktree isolation and review workflows assume a Git repository and are best used by people comfortable with branches, diffs and merge decisions.
Provider capabilities differ: auto-approve, resume, hooks and initial-prompt support are not identical across every supported CLI.

rationale.en: Emdash solves a specific, recurring workflow problem for developers who run several coding agents: parallel execution without sharing one checkout, followed by diff, pull-request and CI review. The project has 5,564 GitHub stars, 573 forks, a year of public history, 154 GitHub releases and a release published on the review date. Product Hunt and Reddit include hands-on feedback that confirms both the value of worktree isolation and real setup, resource and provider-compatibility friction. This is sufficient market and durability evidence for a validated listing, while the page must still disclose that Emdash is unnecessary for single-agent users and that provider accounts, resource use and platform compatibility remain separate concerns.
rationale.zh: Emdash 解决的是开发者同时运行多个编码 agent 时反复出现的具体问题：通过独立 Git worktree 并行执行，再集中审查 diff、PR 和 CI。项目现有 5,564 个 GitHub stars、573 个 forks、约一年的公开历史、154 个 GitHub releases，并在核验当天仍发布新版本。Product Hunt 和 Reddit 的实测反馈同时验证了 worktree 隔离的价值，也暴露了安装、资源占用和 provider 兼容性摩擦。证据足以将其判定为通过市场验证，但页面仍需明确：只使用单一 agent 的用户通常不需要它，provider 账号、资源消耗和平台兼容性也需要分别评估。

notIdealFor: Non-technical users who do not work with Git repositories
Teams seeking one bundled AI model subscription instead of managing provider access
pricingSnapshot: The desktop application is free and open source under Apache-2.0. Agent-provider accounts, APIs or infrastructure may have separate costs. Verified 2026-09-01 on the official site and repository.
summary: Emdash is an open-source desktop environment for running multiple coding agents in isolated Git worktrees and reviewing their changes in one place.
title: Emdash
useCases: Isolate agent work with Git worktrees
Review agent diffs and pull requests

compareAxes: Human handoff and shared inbox access
decisionReason: The official product, pricing, knowledge-base and developer pages verify the support workflow, current plan limits, channels, retention and API boundaries. The candidate can enter draft review but is not automatically publishable.
detail: Owlish is a customer-support agent platform that grounds answers in websites, uploaded documents and direct canonical responses. It combines cited AI answers with conversation review, human handoff and a shared helpdesk on higher tiers. Plans are limited by monthly chat sessions, processed knowledge-base capacity, agents, members and channels rather than a single unlimited chatbot allowance.
limitations: Free is limited to one agent, 25 monthly chat sessions, a 0.5 MB processed knowledge base, one member, web-widget deployment and seven-day conversation retention.
Human handoff, the shared helpdesk inbox and API access start on Growth rather than Free or Starter.
API and MCP access are available only on Growth and Scale, are limited to 100 requests per minute per key, and do not have a separate public sandbox.
Programmatic agent creation, billing changes, channel installation and session webhooks are not currently exposed by the public API.
Email and Instagram are listed as included when available rather than currently available on the reviewed pricing page.

rationale.en: Owlish presents a clear source-cited support workflow, transparent pricing and documented technical limits. However, it launched only a few months ago and the reviewed independent listings contain no user reviews or durable customer-adoption evidence, so it remains an emerging product rather than a market-validated recommendation.
rationale.zh: Owlish 的来源引用式客服流程、定价和技术限制较透明，但产品上线仅数月，已核查的独立平台尚无用户评价，也缺少持续客户采用证据，因此目前属于值得观察的新兴产品，而不是已经通过市场验证的推荐。

notIdealFor: Teams needing an unlimited or high-volume free support bot
Developers who require a complete API-only setup and billing workflow
Buyers who need email or Instagram support to be generally available today
pricingSnapshot: Free: $0. Monthly: Starter $49, Growth $149, Scale $449. Annual billing shows effective monthly prices of $39, $119 and $359, billed as $468, $1,428 and $4,308 per year. Verified 2026-09-01 on the official pricing page.
summary: Owlish builds customer-support agents from websites, files and documented answers, with citations, shared handoff workflows and multiple deployment channels.
title: Owlish
